add.Label: Add damage
add.Hint: Adds dice, a flat amount or a stat to the damage of each matching hit.
add.OptionHint: A Rank damage die is not doubled on a Critical Hit.

Option.rank: Rank die (not doubled on a crit)

multiply.Label: Multiply damage
multiply.Hint: Multiplies the damage of each matching hit, for one damage type or all of it.

suppress_stat.Label: Suppress stat bonus
suppress_stat.Hint: The matching hits add no stat bonus to their damage, for one damage type or all of it.

resistance.Label: Resistance
resistance.Hint: Halves the damage of each matching hit, for one damage type or all of it.

immunity.Label: Immunity
immunity.Hint: The holder takes no damage of the matching type, or of any type when none is named.

tempHp.Label: Temp HP
tempHp.Hint: Adds Temp HP to the holder while the row's condition matches.

reduction.Label: Reduction %
reduction.Hint: Cuts each matching hit by a percentage, a flat amount, or both.

dr.Label: Damage Resist (DR)
dr.Hint: Damage Resist: each matching hit loses up to this much damage before it lands.

evade.Label: Evade bonus
evade.Hint: Adds to the holder's Evade while the row's condition matches.

vulnerability.Label: Vulnerability
vulnerability.Hint: The holder takes double damage from each matching hit, for one damage type or all of it.

suppress_dr.Label: Suppress DR
suppress_dr.Hint: Damage Resist does not apply to the matching hits, for one damage type or all of it.

healthBarScale.Label: Health Bar scale
healthBarScale.Hint: Each Health Bar slot holds this many times its HP: damage reaching the bar is divided by it.

effectImmunity.Label: Immune to effect
effectImmunity.Hint: The row's condition is the effect: a Debuff or a contested Skill or Spell it matches does not land.

reflect.Label: Damage Reflection
reflect.Hint: When one blow costs the holder at least this many Health Bar slots, the holder may make the attacker lose slots.

evadeOutcome.Label: Area Evade
evadeOutcome.Hint: What a successful Evade does against an area attack.

attackerAdvantage.Label: Attackers' Advantage
attackerAdvantage.Hint: Whoever attacks the holder rolls with Advantage (or Disadvantage) while the row's condition matches.

bonus.Label: Bonus
bonus.Hint: Adds a flat value, dice or the stat's modifier to each matching roll.

advantage.Label: Advantage
advantage.Hint: Gives Advantage or Disadvantage on each matching roll.

assist.Label: Assist dice
assist.Hint: Changes the dice an assist skill (Call a Play, Intervene) rolls. Never touches ordinary checks.

reroll.Label: Reroll after the roll
reroll.Hint: After the check is rolled, its roller may roll it again and keep the new result. When the row sits on an item, that item's cooldown gates each use.

degreeShift.Label: Shift the degree
degreeShift.Hint: After the check is rolled, its roller may move the result's degree by Value steps. A Fail never shifts past Near Miss into a success. When the row sits on an item, that item's cooldown gates each use.

waive.Label: Waive a roll penalty
waive.Hint: The roll penalty named by the option does not apply to the rolls this row matches.

add.Label: Add
add.Hint: Adds to a matching spell's Mana cost. Adds apply first, then multiplies, and the cost rounds up.

multiply.Label: Multiply
multiply.Hint: Multiplies a matching spell's Mana cost after the adds, and the cost rounds up.

default.Label: Recovery
default.Hint: Multiplies the Mana or HP a matching rest restores, for the resource the row names.

default.Label: AI Favor rating
default.Hint: Gives the AI Favor rating of a matching weapon, weapon Skill or attack. The highest matching rating applies; ratings do not stack.

default.Label: Popularity
default.Hint: Awards or takes Popularity when the named event happens: a natural 20 or 1 on a roll, or a kill. A once-per limit asks for a Rule Break before the award.

default.Label: Stat substitution
default.Hint: Uses another stat in place of the one a roll would use, for the scope the row names. The matching row with the best modifier applies.

stat.Label: Stat minimum
stat.Hint: A Stat that must be at least this high. Only the unenhanced score counts.

skillRank.Label: Skill Rank
skillRank.Hint: A Skill at this Rank or higher: a named Skill, one of a list, or any Skill matching tags.

popularity.Label: Popularity
popularity.Hint: A Popularity score of at least this.

floor.Label: Floor
floor.Hint: The crawler is on at least this Floor.

race.Label: Race
race.Hint: The crawler already has this Race, one of a list, or a Race matching tags.

class.Label: Class
class.Hint: The crawler already has this Class, one of a list, or a Class matching tags.

achievement.Label: Achievement
achievement.Hint: The crawler owns this achievement (or one of a list).

tags.Label: Tags
tags.Hint: The crawler's tags, with this race or class applied, must match: needs all, needs one of, cannot have.

note.Label: Note (GM decides)
note.Hint: A condition the system cannot judge. Shown as GM decides; never unmet.

worship.Label: Worships a deity
worship.Hint: The crawler worships a deity: a named one, one of a list, one matching tags, or any. A minimum tier of 2 is Devotee, 3 is Zealot.

patron.Label: Has a patron
patron.Hint: Has this patron, a patron item or a god: a named one, one of a list, one matching tags, or any.

item.Label: Item
item.Hint: Gives this item (gear, loot, a consumable or a skill potion) when the box is opened.

spell.Label: Spell tome
spell.Hint: Gives a Tome of this spell, read later to learn it at the listed Rank.

gold.Label: Gold
gold.Hint: Adds gold when the box is opened. A whole number or a dice formula such as 2d6*10.

table.Label: Roll table
table.Hint: Rolls the table when the box is opened and gives what it rolls. It can roll several times, and turn each roll into a skill potion of a custom Skill or a placeholder item.

magicItem.Label: Generated magic item
magicItem.Hint: Generates a fresh magic item when the box is opened. A blank tier uses the box's own tier.

choice.Label: Choice
choice.Hint: The opener picks one thing matching the tags: an item, a Tome of a spell, or a potion for a skill.

stat.Label: Stat bonus
stat.Hint: Adds to one Stat, sized by the box tier. A second Stat result picks a different Stat.

skill.Label: Skill bonus
skill.Hint: Adds Skill Ranks to a skill the crawler owns (any skill when they own none), sized by the box tier.

passiveSkill.Label: Passive skill
passiveSkill.Hint: Grants a passive skill at the current floor's number.

spell.Label: Spell
spell.Hint: Grants a spell at a Rank sized by the box tier, with 2 hours of cooldown per Rank.

resistance.Label: Resistance
resistance.Hint: Resistance to one of the listed damage types. With no list, the GM picks the type.

buff.Label: Buff
buff.Hint: A benefit the GM decides. Recorded on the item for the GM to finish.

restore.Label: Restore
restore.Hint: A restoring effect the GM decides. Recorded on the item for the GM to finish.

maxBonus.Label: Highest bonus level
maxBonus.Hint: The most this crafter can enchant at. Above it the craft asks a Rule Break. The highest matching row wins; with no matching row there is no limit.

time.Label: Crafting time
time.Hint: Multiplies the hours a craft takes (0.5 halves them). Matching rows multiply.

batchTime.Label: Batch time
batchTime.Hint: Multiplies the minutes a batch adds for each extra unit. Matching rows multiply.

rebuild.Label: Rebuild destroyed items
rebuild.Hint: A Repair check can rebuild a destroyed item without a Rule Break. Condition it on item.destroyed.

tableTier.Label: Table tier multiplier
tableTier.Hint: Multiplies the crafting table's tier for checks this row matches. 0 = tables give no bonus.

bonusValue.Label: Extra bonus value
bonusValue.Hint: Adds this much to the numbers an enchantment writes, with no extra Difficulty or time.

materials.Label: Materials multiplier
materials.Hint: Multiplies the units of every material line and the Misc. Junk a craft needs, rounded up (0.5 halves them, 0 asks for none). Matching rows multiply.

batchAny.Label: Batches any blueprint
batchAny.Hint: A blueprint that is not a batch recipe can be made in a batch where this row applies.

unlockRecipes.Label: Unlocks locked recipes
unlockRecipes.Hint: A blueprint tagged crafting.recipe.<id> stays locked until a matching row applies. Put the recipe tag in the row condition to unlock only those recipes; leave it empty to unlock every recipe.

salvage.Label: Better salvage on failure
salvage.Hint: A failed step returns more materials: each tier moves Major Failure to Failure to Near Miss. A Critical Failure still breaks the item.

moveAdd.Label: Move added
moveAdd.Hint: Adds feet to the vehicle's Move. Rows add together, then the multipliers apply.

moveMultiply.Label: Move multiplier
moveMultiply.Hint: Multiplies the vehicle's Move after the additions (1.5 adds half again). Matching rows multiply.

hpSlotsLost.Label: Health Bar slots lost
hpSlotsLost.Hint: Empty Health Bars on the row owner, or on the target when damage is applied.

rank.Label: Rank
rank.Hint: The Rank of the item carrying the row, the item used, the weapon skill, or an owned item.

stat.Label: Stat Mod
stat.Hint: The row owner's modifier for the chosen stat.

statValue.Label: Stat score
statValue.Hint: The row owner's score (not the modifier) for the chosen stat, such as seconds equal to Intelligence.

count.Label: Count of creatures
count.Hint: Party members, allies, enemies or owned items matching a tag query.

move.Label: Move
move.Hint: The row owner's Move in feet (write per: 0.1 for "per 10ft").

worshipTier.Label: Tier of Devotion
worshipTier.Hint: The Tier (1-3) of the god whose gift carries the row, or of the highest god worshipped. A god not worshipped reads 0.

CopyBlueprint.Hint: GM only. Writes a new blueprint from this item's enchantments.
